criteria.description: [R-1] `from app_int.main import round_number` succeeds and `round_number` is callable.
[R-8] `type(round_number(2.4)) is int`, `type(round_number(1250, -2)) is int`, and `type(round_number(2.4, 1)) is float`.
[R-13] Calling `round_number(2.5)` twice returns the same result both times and produces no stdout/stderr output.
[N-1] `round_number` has type annotations for both parameters and its return value, and a non-empty docstring that names the half-away-from-zero tie rule.
[N-2] The `dependencies` list in `pyproject.toml` is unchanged (still empty).
[N-3] `health_check() == {"status": "ok"}` and `add(2, 3) == 5` still hold, and the pre-existing tests in `tests/test_main.py` pass unchanged.
[N-4] `uv run pytest -q` exits with status 0 and `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
[N-5] At least one test under `tests/` imports and exercises `round_number`.
